description: minimumReleaseAge holds a version bump for 3 days. Automerge reaches root-equivalent containers and gitops_reconcile applies a merge within ~15 min, so an unheld bump could be live in one cycle with nobody in the loop.

internalChecksFilter is strict, so a too-young version opens no PR at all. vulnerabilityAlerts clears minimumReleaseAge with prCreation immediate, so an OSV fix still lands at once. Digest updates and container images are exempt — see the rules below.

customManagers.description: Container image refs pinned in role vars; quadlet templates render them.
The disaster-recovery runbook hardcodes the mariadb roles/wordpress pins, so its fallback SQL load runs on that engine. Same depName, so both bump in one PR.
Grafana dashboard revisions pinned in role vars; the role fetches them at converge.
Packer for the lint gate's packer-fmt/packer-validate hooks; no zypper package, and it cannot have one — cracklib owns the name.
Packer plugins, pinned exactly because packer init writes no lock file.
butane for the lint gate; the binary comes out of a digest-pinned image because the GitHub release ships signatures but no checksums.
tflint for CI and the workstation; no zypper package. One depName, so tflint_version and dev_tflint_version bump together.
OpenTofu for both workflows' setup-opentofu; no zypper package. One depName, so both bump together; terraform.yml's destructive-plan gate guards the apply a bump fires, so minor/patch automerge.
Hugo for peaceiris/actions-hugo in the Firebase and go.sum autofix workflows; no zypper/pip package.
firebase-tools runs the keyless deploy in the Firebase workflows.
The ansible MCP server pinned in .mcp.json; no pip/zypper package.
required_version constrains the OpenTofu CLI, but the terraform manager mis-tracks it as hashicorp/terraform (disabled below). hashicorp versioning parses the ~> range.

packageRules.description: Grafana dashboard revisions are bare incrementing integers.
pinDigest carries no version change, so the lint check is enough to merge it unattended.

Renovate reads no releaseTimestamp for a digest (renovate#38656), and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so these park forever on a stability-days check no elapsed time clears. Sets no automerge, so the cadvisor/caddy rule below still holds.
No registry read here returns a releaseTimestamp, so a container version bump parks the same way. The rule above covers digests on the other datasources, where the github-actions pins live.

No unattended bump where a compromised image reads the host or fronts the internet. cadvisor runs as root with a read-only bind of the whole host filesystem; caddy terminates TLS for the public sites, holds the Cloudflare API token, and alone publishes 80/443. node_exporter is deliberately absent: it mounts the host D-Bus system bus, but runs as an unprivileged uid systemd refuses StartTransientUnit, and its molecule verify asserts that user. Must stay after the pinDigest rule — later rules win, and flatten reapplies packageRules after the update-type presets, so this has the last word.

gitops_reconcile installs this ansible and applies the fleet as root, so an unattended bump is unread root code on every host. Hashing the pin would not help: pip's hash mode is per-invocation, so it would force a hashed closure onto requirements-dev.txt too.
linuxserver images carry legacy build-number, two-part and four-part tags that docker versioning reads as upgrades; their releases are strict semver.
lidarr has a legacy 8.1.2135 tag that even strict semver accepts; mainline is 3.x.
Merging a plex bump restarts the container and kills active streams.
Hard dep of hetzner.hcloud's vendored SDK, which imports dateutil.parser.isoparse. Stable, not abandoned — just release-inactive.

config:best-practices skips indirect gomod deps, so enable them for this go.mod or the Blowfish theme never updates. site-gate catches a break, and hugo-gosum-autofix completes go.sum and re-triggers it.
required_version is the OpenTofu CLI, not HashiCorp Terraform; the custom manager above tracks it.
